note: P and Q are all tapered cone lamps with a right-hand control card on a dark ground (P varies metal and palette, Q varies mostly metal and wax colour, with Q3 pixelated); R has the most variation in vessel shape (round bulb, spire, slim bottle), staging (bottom control bar vs side card) and palette (ember, violet, orange). Q3 nearly breaks the fixed 'lit from below' and 'blobs of wax in liquid' brief: dark glass with almost no glow and wax stalled in a blocky mass.
